title: The HireVue preparation pack: what to know for any firm
subtitle: The eight things every firm is checking, the twenty sentences that cover them, and where to find each one in an hour. TP ICAP is filled in as the example.

points.head: Eight things.
points.text: Every question, however it is worded, is checking one of them.

points.head: Twenty sentences.
points.text: Fourteen about the firm and the job. Six about you.

points.head: Three steps for every fact.
points.text: The fact. Which means. Which is why I.

meta: Prepared 26 November 2026. TP ICAP facts checked against its documents up to 3 November 2026.
how: Coloured boxes show example words. Grey is a weak answer, green is a strong one, blue is a line to say out loud.
Sam, who gives the example answers, is made up. Lines that start Your version point to things from your own life.
